name: Dialogue Box
description: Branching NPC dialogue renderer with typed-text effect and choice buttons. It opens at the tree's start or at a node the caller names, passes a choice's `act` through untouched for whichever component acts on it, and lets a listener that answers a choice by opening another node have the last word.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.

inputs.name: tree
inputs.description: Dialogue tree {start, nodes: {id: {speaker?, text, choices: [{label, to, act?}]}}}. `to` null ends the conversation. `act` is any object, passed through on ui.dialogueChoiceMade unread. Every node a conversation can reach needs at least one choice, because a node with none can only be closed.

outputs.name: start
outputs.description: start(at?): opens at `at`, or at the tree's start. False, with ui.dialogueEnded, when there is no tree or no such node.

outputs.name: choose
outputs.description: choose(i): announces ui.dialogueChoiceMade {from, label, to, act}, then moves to `to`, unless a listener opened another node while hearing it, in which case that node stands. A null `to` ends the conversation.

outputs.name: close
outputs.description: close(): ends the conversation where it stands, with ui.dialogueEnded {reason: 'closed'}.
